subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers retire this broad field-report issue after splitting the remaining slices into owner-scoped issues, or keep it open as the umbrella tracker?
rationale: The report spans config recovery, Discord/channel delivery, cron ergonomics, web search, setup auth, resource policy, and update process behavior; current main only proves partial fixes, so the useful next state is a maintainer workflow and product-scope decision rather than an autonomous repair.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Move unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, keep the active config and missed-inbound trackers as durable references, then close this issue after links are complete.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad production field-report tracker until every historical slice is fixed, rejected, or separately tracked.

options.title: Close as superseded now
options.body: Close this issue now with links to the active canonical trackers, accepting that weaker slices may need fresh focused reports if they recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Move unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, keep the active config and missed-inbound trackers as durable references, then close this issue after links are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is cross-surface product routing and issue hygiene rather than a single code-owner fix, and this person has the strongest observed routing context among the likely owners.
